parameters.name: ApiName
parameters.description: The operation that you want to perform.

parameters.name: ApiVersion
parameters.description:
The version number of the API.

>  You can call the [DescribeGroupProductions](~~DescribeGroupProductions~~) operation to query version numbers.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the response. Valid values:

*   **zh** (default): Chinese.
*   **en**: English.

parameters.name: PopCode
parameters.description: The POP code of the Alibaba Cloud service.

parameters.name: RoleFor
parameters.description: The ID of the user who switches from the current view to the destination view by using the management account.

parameters.name: RoleType
parameters.description:
The type of the view. Valid values:

*   0 (default): the view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.
*   1: the view of all accounts for the enterprise.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sophonsoar describe-open-api-info --pop-code Sas --biz-api-version 2018-12-03 --api-name DescribePopApiItemList --lang zh --role-type 0 --role-for 1592757002956 --api-version 2022-07-28 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sophonsoar DescribeOpenApiInfo --region cn-hangzhou --ApiVersion '2018-12-03' --ApiName DescribePopApiItemList --RoleType 0 --PopCode Sas --Lang zh --RoleFor 1592757002956
